summary: Euroculture is an Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in European studies, culture and society, based in Groningen, Netherlands. Applications for the 2027-2029 edition opened on 15 October 2026. To be considered for an Erasmus Mundus scholarship, a complete application must be submitted by 15 January 2027. The scholarship covers participation fees, health insurance and living costs of EUR 1,400 per month.
highlights: First higher education degree, or recognised equivalent, by the deadline; an official document confirming completion is sufficient.
English test results must arrive by 15 January 2027 for scholarship consideration.
Erasmus Mundus scholarship covers participation fees, health insurance and EUR 1,400 per month in living costs.
